use_case: Small business credit underwriting model: scores applications under $250,000 and returns a recommendation and the top 4 reason codes to the loan origination system
vendor_or_model: AI model vendor (gradient-boosted machine learning model, deployed in the bank's cloud tenant as the credit decisioning service, SYS-10)
data_categories: Business bank account cash-flow data; business credit bureau data; owners' personal credit scores; time in business; industry; loan amount and collateral; a vendor location risk index (customer information and NPI)
human_in_the_loop: Loan officer makes and documents every decision; from 2026-09-15 a second credit officer reviews every model-recommended decline before notice
applicable_laws: ECOA and Regulation B (12 CFR 1002.4, 1002.6, 1002.9); GLBA and the Interagency Guidelines (12 CFR 30 App. B, including III.D service provider oversight)
status: In production as a pilot at 3 branches since May 2026; expansion on hold until conditions are met

use_case: Online banking login and transaction fraud scoring by the digital banking provider (device and behavior risk scores that trigger step-up checks or holds)
vendor_or_model: Digital banking provider (embedded machine learning service)
data_categories: Customer device, login, and transaction data (NPI)
consequential_decision_category: None (fraud prevention; a hold is reviewed by staff)
human_in_the_loop: Deposit operations and treasury staff review held transactions and release or return them
applicable_laws: GLBA and the Interagency Guidelines (III.C.1.f monitoring; III.D service provider oversight)
status: In production; provider documentation requested; full assessment due 2027-06-30

use_case: General-purpose generative AI chatbots used by staff to draft letters and summaries
data_categories: Risk of customer information being pasted
risk_tier: Low if no customer data; High if customer information is entered
applicable_laws: GLBA and the Interagency Guidelines (customer information must stay in approved systems)
status: Prohibited for customer, SAR, and loan information (POL-05 4.10; POL-04 4.8); an enterprise tool is under evaluation
